class="bio inset"><div><p>Food policy & planning across Europe</p><p>I am a PhD. urban planner that works with cities and regions across Europe on food policy and planning. My doctoral research with shepherds on the outskirts of Bucharest examined how urban expansion affects grazing land and the livelihoods of people who supply the city with food.</p><p>In France, I helped evaluate a territorial food strategy for the Clermont-Ferrand urban planning agency and served on the scientific committee for the Combrailles food strategy. Today, my work centres on the right to food: how residents, producers and public authorities can shape food policy together.</p><p><strong>Urban Agenda for the EU — Food Partnership</strong><br>As an external expert, I contributed research, policy analysis and recommendations for Actions 2 and 3: strengthening national and regional support for local food policies, and connecting local food strategies with regional programmes and smart specialisation strategies.<br><a href="https://www.urbanagenda.urban-initiative.eu/library/action-2-and-3-food-action-plan-final-reporting-and-recommendations" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">https://www.urbanagenda.urban-initiative.eu/library/action-2-and-3-food-action-plan-final-reporting-and-recommendations</a></p><p>I also co-authored the 2023 ex-ante assessment that informed the establishment of the Food Partnership.<br><a href="https://www.urbanagenda.urban-initiative.eu/sites/default/files/2023-07/EAA%20report%20Food.pdf" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">https://www.urbanagenda.urban-initiative.eu/sites/default/files/2023-07/EAA%20report%20Food.pdf</a></p><p><strong>Bucharest Food Conversations — Founder</strong></p><p>I founded Bucharest Food Conversations to bring people who grow, cook and distribute food into the same conversation as those who make policy for the city. Following our April 2026 workshop, Ioana Elisabeta Enache and I brought participants’ proposals together in the Bucharest Food Manifesto and a roadmap for a Bucharest Food Council.</p><p>LinkedIn: <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/bucharest-food-conversations/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">https://www.linkedin.com/company/bucharest-food-conversations/</a><br>Bucharest Food Manifesto: <a href="https://lnkd.in/d6iTJiGa" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">https://lnkd.in/d6iTJiGa</a><br>Roadmap for the Bucharest Food Council: <a href="https://lnkd.in/dxAUT6Nc" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">https://lnkd.in/dxAUT6Nc</a></p><p><strong>ROOTED — Bucharest Living Lab coordinator</strong></p><p>I coordinate the Bucharest Living Lab for Climato Sfera within the Horizon Europe project ROOTED. We explore how neighbourhood kitchens can work with local growers, shepherds and markets to make good food more accessible. We also ask what these kitchens need from public authorities to become a lasting part of neighbourhood life.</p><p>LinkedIn: <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/rootedlandedcommunitykitchens/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">https://www.linkedin.com/company/rootedlandedcommunitykitchens/</a></p><p><strong>ReGreenEat — Food policy expert</strong></p><p>Through the Romanian Centre for European Policies (CRPE), I help coordinate ReGreenEat and develop activities with residents and staff in three Bucharest care centres. Through adapted gardening, cooking together and consultations about meals, we work towards a practical goal: residents having more say in what they eat.</p><p>Project page: <a href="https://www.climatosfera.org/proiecte-mediu/regreeneat" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">https://www.climatosfera.org/proiecte-mediu/regreeneat</a></p><p><strong>EuroFoodXchange — Galați</strong><br>I contributed to Galați’s food-system assessment and the development of its local food strategy through stakeholder dialogue, participatory workshops and exchanges with European cities. I also contributed to the project’s methodological resources for local authorities.</p><p>Galați report — English:<br><a href="https://rebrand.ly/galati-EN" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">https://rebrand.ly/galati-EN</a></p><p>Galați report — Romanian:<br><a href="https://rebrand.ly/galati-RO" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">https://rebrand.ly/galati-RO</a></p><p>Methodological guide — English:<br><a href="https://rebrand.ly/guide-methodo-EFXC-EN" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">https://rebrand.ly/guide-methodo-EFXC-EN</a></p><p>Methodological guide — Romanian:<br><a href="https://rebrand.ly/guide-methodo-EFXC-RO" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">https://rebrand.ly/guide-methodo-EFXC-RO</a></p><p><strong>AESOP4Food — Teaching and capacity building</strong><br>I co-coordinated AESOP4Food and contributed to its teaching and learning resources for sustainable food planning.
